title: Pipe Cleaner Flowers
shortDescription: Beautiful handmade flowers created with colourful pipe cleaners and thoughtful details. Ideal for room decoration, desk décor, and gifting.
description: Bright, cheerful pipe cleaner flowers that add colour to your room, desk or special occasion. Crafted with high-grade soft chenille stems with flexible wire cores, these flowers never wilt, need zero watering, and bring a cheerful touch to any corner.

specifications.Material: Premium Chenille Pipe Cleaners & Flexible Core
specifications.Care: Dust gently with a soft dry brush; keep away from direct water
specifications.Customisation: Available in pastel pink, peach, lilac, sunflower yellow, baby blue & more

title: Flower Bouquets
shortDescription: Give flowers that stay bright. Handmade pipe cleaner bouquets that are a creative, everlasting alternative to traditional flowers.
description: Long-lasting handmade bouquets that stay beautiful without watering or daily maintenance. Beautifully styled with tulips, daisies, foliage and lavender stems, wrapped in premium matte translucent wrapping and tied with a satin ribbon.
priceNote: Depends on bouquet size and design
options: Choice of wrapping paper & satin ribbons

specifications.Material: Chenille pipe cleaners, florist tape, premium wrap & satin bow
specifications.Care: Keep in an indoor vase; zero water required
specifications.Dimensions: Available in mini (15-20cm), classic (25-30cm), and grand (35cm+)
specifications.Customisation: Custom colour palettes, flower counts, and theme coordination

title: Handmade Keychains
shortDescription: Cute and creative keychains designed for bags, keys and everyday accessories. Lightweight and crafted with durable chenille stems.
description: Lightweight, colourful keychains for bags, keys and everyday accessories. Choose from charming floral charms, sweet bunny faces, and colourful shapes, or request a custom charm matching your favourite colors.

specifications.Material: Soft pipe cleaners, reinforced inner core, alloy key ring & clasp
specifications.Care: Spot clean gently with dry cloth
specifications.Customisation: Choose charm style, colors, and initial tag if requested

title: Hair Accessories
shortDescription: Playful handmade accessories that add a creative touch to everyday style. Lightweight, comfortable, and gentle on hair.
description: Add a little colour to everyday style with handmade hair accessories designed to be playful, lightweight and easy to wear. Featuring floral hairpins, butterfly clips, and charming floral claws crafted from chenille stems.
options: Floral clips, hairpins, and claw attachments
Gentle grip suitable for all hair types
Custom color sets for outfits or events

specifications.Material: Soft chenille flowers securely mounted on hair clips/bobby pins
specifications.Care: Keep dry and store in accessory pouch
specifications.Customisation: Available in sets of 2, 4 or custom single statement clips

title: Mini Figures
shortDescription: Bring home a tiny handmade friend. Cute little handmade characters that are perfect for collecting, gifting or displaying.
description: Cute little handmade characters that are perfect for collecting, gifting or decorating a study table, shelf or bedroom. Each figurine is sculpted by hand with careful details, expressive postures, and cheerful colors.
options: Bunny, chick, bear, and puppy characters
Holding mini flowers, hearts, or stars
Custom character requests based on feasibility
Compact desktop or shelf display size

specifications.Material: High-density fuzzy chenille stems, bead accents, stable base
specifications.Care: Keep away from moisture and dust with soft brush
specifications.Customisation: Custom accessories or character colors available

title: Gift Hampers
shortDescription: Make your gift more personal with a thoughtfully arranged handmade hamper for birthdays, celebrations, and return gifts.
description: Thoughtfully arranged handmade gifts for birthdays, celebrations, return gifts and special occasions. A hamper can include selected products such as flowers, keychains, mini figures, accessories or décor pieces, nestled with fairy lights and a handwritten message.
priceNote: Depends on selected items and hamper budget
options: Curated combination of bouquets, keychains, and accessories
Aesthetic kraft gift box with shredded paper & fairy lights
Bulk hamper discounts for return gifts & events
